title: Transcription Accuracy Oracle Fixture
description: Ground-truth word timestamps for evaluating ASR pipeline accuracy. Oracle timestamps are hand-labeled from audio; actual timestamps come from a .toaster project file.

source_project.description: Relative path to the .toaster project file containing actual transcription results

engine.description: Engine/model ID used for the transcription (e.g., 'parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3')

labeled_by.description: Who labeled the oracle timestamps (for provenance)

labeled_at.description: When the oracle timestamps were labeled

words.description: Ground-truth word timestamps. Order must match the .toaster project word order.

text.description: Word text (must match .toaster project word text)

median_error_us.description: Maximum acceptable median absolute error in microseconds (default: 100000 = 100ms)

p95_error_us.description: Maximum acceptable 95th percentile error in microseconds (default: 500000 = 500ms)
